svg.title: The seven organisms on the spine
svg.desc: Drawn by docs/book/figures.py from the code of Omni-Compass.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(40%,40%,40%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: none; fill-rule: evenodd; stroke-dasharray: 4, 3;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11px;fill: rgb(10%,10%,10%); stroke:none;

g.text: 6. The whole tower: 1,107 distinct muscles in 70 families, every muscle once

rect.style: stroke: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(90%,93%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px;fill: rgb(10%,10%,10%); stroke:none;

g.text: THE SPINE: 267 muscles, every muscle that sits in all four realms

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11px;fill: rgb(10%,10%,10%); stroke:none;
